grammarRule.formula: Since + Starting point (Since 2020) | For + Period (For 3 years)

explanation.ml: Since vs For (കാലയളവ് പറയൽ) എന്ന വിഷയത്തിൽ Since + Starting point (Since 2020) | For + Period (For 3 years) എങ്ങനെ ഉപയോഗിക്കണം എന്ന് വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Learn how to use Since + Starting point (Since 2020) | For + Period (For 3 years) correctly in spoken English.

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: I have lived here for 5 years.
goldenTip.en: Golden Rule: Practice 'I have lived here for 5 years.' with zero hesitation.
